channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Colorado Democrats want to protect the civil rights of students with disabilities
item.description: Legislation in the works would task the state education department with investigating complaints of schools falling short in serving kids with 504 plans, which allow for modifications in the classroom

item.title: Lake Powell forecast to reach critical lows, threatening hydropower generation
item.description: The most dire outlook from the Bureau of Reclamation anticipates water flowing into the massive reservoir at only 37% of a 30-year average

item.title: Avalanche hazard spikes across Colorado as biggest snowstorms of the season land this week
item.description: The Colorado Avalanche Information Center is warning of increased avalanche danger in the northern, central and southern mountains as new snow and high winds bury a weak snowpack

item.title: Colorado State University named a finalist to be the system’s next chancellor. To some, the search was a sham.
item.description: Campus organizations say they don’t want to diminish the qualifications of sole finalist Rico Munn, but think the process should have looked beyond internal candidates

item.title: Federal proposal limiting foreign scientists at Boulder lab disrupts Colorado’s quantum industry
item.description: A proposed update to a federal security policy on government-funded research could shut out non-US associates at NIST, the federal lab, after March 31.

item.title: Heat pump installations in Colorado more than doubled in 2025 as rebates expired and contractors mastered service
item.description: Xcel Energy and Tri-State primed the heat pump boom, training hundreds of private installers to help encourage the shift to clean heating and cooling

item.title: Colorado AG sues to claw back $600 million in energy research grants canceled by Trump
item.description: Attorney General Phil Weiser joins California, other states saying big clean energy funds were illegally canceled

item.title: Dog that killed Colorado 7-year-old came from pit bull rescue with several license violations, records show
item.description: The Montrose Bully Breed Club, which advocates for pit bull breeds, said it had relinquished its state license and would no longer assist with fostering or adopting

item.title: Parts of beloved El Rancho building will move, “preserving the essence,” as huge gas station takes its place
item.description: Evergreen, county officials praise a compromise that moves elements of the building to a new public arts pavilion, but big QuikTrip at El Rancho exit remains controversial

item.title: Colorado lawmakers want police to take new steps when responding to domestic violence calls
item.description: House Bill 1009, known as the Colorado Mandatory Lethality Assessment Act, is centered around how police officers screen survivors when they respond to domestic violence incidents
